tagline: Ingredients checked. Your preferences come next.
description: Declared ingredients are checked against applicable refusal rules. Labels, warnings and missing evidence remain visible.

copy.unit_basis: Price for the exact pack. No nutritional or efficacy equivalence is implied.
copy.screening_note: Published references have a readable, complete ingredient declaration checked against the applicable ingredient restrictions in charter 0.15.0. This first filter does not certify nutritional quality, efficacy or laboratory testing.
copy.audience_note: Food preferences and nutritional comparisons are separate from this ingredient filter. Check the product declaration for your dietary needs and allergies.
copy.guide_heading: How do you like your coffee?
copy.empty_body: We reviewed 191 coffee products reaching Kuwait and published none. Publication requires a completed ingredient check and an available Kuwait offer. Unresolved declarations and unavailable offers remain in the audit.

milk_allergy_empty.title: Nothing here is free of milk.
milk_allergy_empty.body: Every product published in this category declares milk, or has no dairy-free declaration we could read. We will not answer a declared milk allergy from silence.

director_selection.note: Editorial choices among ingredient-admitted references, recorded in the database.
